facts.business: Triumph International Finance India Limited is a finance company that has not carried out any major business during the year and whose stock-broker registration was cancelled by SEBI.

auditor.name: Rawat & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) going concern uncertainty as SEBI cancelled stock-broker registration, NSE declared company a defaulter, appeal dismissed by Apex Court, and recovery of debts doubtful; (b) Rs 67.09 crore receivable from Classic Credit Limited considered doubtful; (c) Rs 3.56 crore paid to Panther Investrade Limited with pending DRT matters, recoverability uncertain; (d) unrecognised interest liability on Rs 46.76 crore loan from Punjab National Bank (erstwhile Oriental Bank of Commerce) not compliant with Ind AS 37 and Ind AS 109; (e) ownership of shares and securities and dividend income of Rs 13.08 lakh unverifiable.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to cancellation of stock-broker registration by SEBI and declaration as defaulter by NSE
Doubtful recovery of Rs 67.09 crore from Classic Credit Limited
Uncertain recoverability of Rs 3.56 crore paid to Panther Investrade Limited with pending DRT matters
Unrecognised interest liability on Rs 46.76 crore loan from Punjab National Bank
Unverifiable ownership of shares and securities and dividend income of Rs 13.08 lakh
